description: It reads from webhook.site, the test service: for each delivery the time, the method and the exact content that was sent. The address holds sample payloads only, never participant data, because only fabricated samples go to a mirror since 16.11.2026. Take it after a test delivery, when a host wants to see what arrived. "Show me what actually arrived." You give the webhook id from the list. It does not touch the host's receiving system. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect, with no example numbers. Read-only, it changes nothing. Words hosts use: webhook payload, delivery log, what arrived, test webhook

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webhook_id.description: The webhook id, as wi_list_webhooks returned it.
